about_the_game:
Chiasmus is a point-and-click adventure horror quest game. The story follows the protagonists Victor and Alexander, who wake up in an unfamiliar apartment they need to escape from. During the search for a way out, Victor discovers a mysterious clock and his ability to interact with it to travel between two worlds. Each of the worlds holds a piece of the puzzle that must be put together to find out how and why they ended up in this apartment. In the other world, a mysterious entity is already waiting for Victor, who knows more about him than it might seem at first. The game features multiple endings that unfold depending on how the protagonist conducts himself throughout the playthrough.

Features:

  • A deep plot with unexpected twists

  • Travel between two worlds

  • An atmospheric world

  • The influence of choices on the development of events and the story's finale

  • Engaging puzzles and intricate riddles

  • Detailed 2D graphics

content_descriptors.notes: This game may contain content not suitable for all ages or for viewing at work: depictions of blood, bones, internal organs, alcohol and cigarettes, a self-harm scene, oppressive and frightening atmosphere, ghosts and supernatural entities.
